units.source_text: 三月某日，天朗气清，萤兵部卿亲王和柏木卫门督来六条院问候。

en.t: One day in March, when the sky was bright and the air was clear, Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, and Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Right Gate Guard, came to Rokujo-in to pay their respects.

units.source_text: 源氏出来接见，相与闲谈。

en.t: Genji came out to receive them, and they chatted together at leisure.

units.source_text: 源氏说道：“我这里四周冷静，这几天更加寂寞，毫无一点新鲜花样。

en.t: Genji said, "Everything around here is quiet, and these past few days have felt even lonelier, with nothing at all fresh or new.

units.source_text: 公私都清闲无事，这日子如何消遣呢？”

en.t: There is nothing to do, either in public or in private; how am I to pass these days?"

units.source_text: 后来又说：“今天早上大将来过，此刻不知到哪儿去了。

en.t: Later he added, "The Captain came here this morning, but I do not know where he has gone now.

units.source_text: 寂寞得厌烦了，叫他带了小弓来射箭，倒很好看呢。

en.t: I have grown so tired of this loneliness that it would be quite pleasant to have him bring a small bow and shoot arrows.

units.source_text: 现在有青年游伴在这里，可惜他已经回去了吧？”

en.t: Now that there are young companions here for amusement, it would be a pity if he had already gone home, would it not?"

units.source_text: 左右的人答道：“大将现在东北院，正在和许多人蹴鞠呢。”

en.t: The attendants nearby replied, "The Captain is now at the Northeast Residence, playing kemari with many people."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“蹴鞠这件事动作粗暴，然而叫人醒目，令人兴奋，倒也好玩。

en.t: Genji said, "Kemari is a rough sort of activity, but it catches the eye, stirs the spirits, and is rather entertaining.
How would it be to call him here and have them play?"
He then sent someone to summon him.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将立刻来了，带了许多公子哥儿之类的人来。

en.t: Captain Yugiri came at once, bringing with him many young noblemen and others of that sort.

units.source_text: 源氏问道：“球带来了没有？

en.t: Genji asked, "Did you bring the ball?
Who are these people who came with you?"

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“他们是某某等人，可否叫他们都到这里来？”

en.t: Yugiri answered, "They are so-and-so and the others; may I call them all over here?"
